   function To_JSON (Model : Create_Agent_Request) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      JS.Set (Result, "name", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Name));
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

      Result : Create_Agent_Request;

      end if;
      return Result;

with UARP.Client;
with UARP.JSON_Support;
package UARP.API.Runs is

   subtype Client_Type is UARP.Client.Client_Type;
   subtype Request_Options is UARP.Client.Request_Options;

   --  DELETE /runs/{runId}
   procedure Delete
     (Self : Client_Type;
      Run_Id : String;
      Options : Request_Options := UARP.Client.Default_Options);

   --  GET /runs/{runId}
   function Get_Run
     (Self : Client_Type;
      Run_Id : String;
      Options : Request_Options := UARP.Client.Default_Options)
      return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;

   --  Collides with getRun after shortening, so both keep their ids
   --
   --  GET /runs/latest
   function Get_Runs
     (Self : Client_Type;
      Options : Request_Options := UARP.Client.Default_Options)
      return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;

   --  Must keep its full name: `listAgent` would lie
   --
   --  GET /agents/{agentId}/runs
   function List_Agent_Runs
     (Self : Client_Type;
      Agent_Id : String;
      Options : Request_Options := UARP.Client.Default_Options)
      return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;

end UARP.API.Runs;

   function Get_Runs
     (Self : Client_Type;
      Options : Request_Options := UARP.Client.Default_Options)
      return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value
   is
   begin
      return UARP.Client.Call
         (Self,

          Options => Options);
   end Get_Runs;

   function List_Agent_Runs
